prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Ramón, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching an all-out war on residents next month, authorized to slap massive, ruinous fines on anyone whose bin is even a minute late. They are hunting for every single violator, so expect total enforcement and constant patrols across every single street."
text: I just heard from someone working directly in the council office that they’re planning strict enforcement on bin times starting next month. They apparently intend to issue heavy fines for any delays, so we should be extra careful to get them out on time.
